Black Friday is on pace for a record — online.

Adobe expects U.S. shoppers to spend about $12.9 billion on retail websites today, up 9.2% from last year's $11.8 billion. The whole season (Nov. 1–Dec. 31) is projected at a record $275.1 billion.

Here's the catch: prices are still higher than a year ago, so part of every 'record' is just inflation — not more stuff in the cart. And the biggest day isn't even today: Adobe projects Cyber Monday at $15.1 billion.

My take: a spending record during a squeeze isn't proof people feel rich. It's proof the deals finally felt worth it — often on credit.

What's the one thing you actually bought this Black Friday? 👇

Source: Adobe Analytics holiday forecast, Nov. 2026
